key: A portion of Mine own Self, transformed in the world of life into an immortal Spirit, draweth round itself the senses of which the mind is the sixth, veiled in matter.
s: Having named his supreme abode, from which none return, Krishna turns to the embodied soul; Śaṅkara (Advaita), Gītā Bhāṣya 15.7, reads this portion as a portion only in imagination, like the sun’s reflection in water, which returns to the sun once the water is removed.
src: Śaṅkara, Gītā Bhāṣya 15.7, trans. A. Mahadeva Sastri, 2nd ed. (1901), archive.org bhagavadgitwith00agoog

opened.edition: A. Mahadeva Sastri, The Bhagavad-Gita with the Commentary of Sri Sankaracharya, 2nd ed. (1901) (OCR)
opened.locator: chapter 15, commentary on 15.7 (read with 15.1 to 15.20, esp. the question closing 15.6)

evidence.words: He is like the sun reflected in water ; the reflected sun is but a portion of the real sun ; and on the removal of water the reflected sun returns to the original sun and remains as that very sun. … it is only a portion limited by the up^dhi sjet. up by avidy^ ; it is a portion as it were, an imaginary portion.
evidence.lang: English (Mahadeva Sastri’s 1901 translation of the Sanskrit)
evidence.gloss: The individual soul is like the sun reflected in water: the reflection is only a portion of the real sun, and when the water is removed it returns to the original sun and remains that very sun. [To the objection that the partless Supreme Self can have no portion:] it is only a portion limited by the upadhi set up by avidya, a portion as it were, an imaginary portion.

reason: Problem holds: in the old wording the relative clause "which returns to the sun" attached to "water", saying the water returns; re-opened Sastri 15.7 via packet.js gita 15 --verse 15.7, which says the reflected sun returns to the original sun on removal of the water. Applied the critic fix: "like the sun’s reflection in water, which returns to the sun once the water is removed", so the clause now attaches to the reflection. Only that phrase changed; commentator, place, key, ref, at and src unchanged. 45 words. verse.js ok (15.7, at 556); entry-check ok. Both evidence pieces verbatim from the packet at 15.7.
